info.title: How the club works
info.subtitle: Your studio's rules and points rate.
info.points_earn: You get 1 point for every {{rate}} spent at the studio. The studio can also gift points separately — for a promo, an invited friend or your birthday.
info.points_spend: When paying in the app, switch on “Use points” — each point takes {{unit}} off the price.
info.points_balance: You have {{points}} points right now — that's {{value}}.
info.points_expiry_3m: Unused points expire 3 months after they were earned.
info.points_expiry_6m: Unused points expire 6 months after they were earned.
info.points_expiry_1y: Unused points expire a year after they were earned.
info.points_grow: The higher your level, the more a point is worth: on the next step it will be {{value}}. Points you already have grow with you — nothing needs to be recalculated.
info.levels_how: Your level is based on everything you've spent at the studio and updates on its own.
info.levels_benefit: A level changes what a point is worth: yours is {{unit}} right now, and on {{level}} it is {{value}}. Points are earned at the same rate on every level — what grows is the value of what you saved.
info.levels_what: A level grants no discount by itself — the studio announces what each level gives.
info.offers_what: A personal discount is issued by the studio — by hand or automatically, for example when you renew a pass. It applies at checkout on its own.
info.offers_once: It is single-use and does not stack: when several discounts fit, the best one for you wins.
info.cert_what: A certificate is a money value that is subtracted from the price of your purchase.
info.cert_how: Tap a certificate to pay for a pass with it, or copy the code and give it to the front desk. A certificate is redeemed in full on one purchase.
info.deposit_what: The deposit is your money held by the studio. It pays for a purchase instead of your card.
info.referral_you_points: You get {{bonus}} points once your invited friend meets the studio's condition.
info.referral_you_money: You get {{bonus}} once your invited friend meets the studio's condition.
info.referral_friend: Your friend gets {{discount}}% off their first purchase made through your link.
info.referral_friend_none: Send a friend your link — it ties their account to yours.
info.order_steps: Discount → certificate → deposit → points → the rest paid by card.
info.order_note: Only what is needed is used: if you have more points than the price, the rest stays on your balance.
